source: PreRequix Global Curriculum & Academic Course Repository
description: PreRequix unified course and curriculum definitions. This JSON file acts as the primary data source and helper for PreRequix. It feeds the database seeder (CurriculumDataLoader), the remote API client (CourseApiClient & RemoteCourseParser), and local curriculum import workflows. Adding a new curriculum or course here automatically makes it available throughout the entire app without recompilation.
